title: Compare observed parts
alt_text: An irregular flower is blocked in with a tilted axis. A horizontal arrow marks the bloom width as one temporary unit; another checks stem length, while gaps and leaf alignments remain visible. A small bottom panel shows a fixed eye point, extended arm, pencil, and thumb-held unit mark.
caption: Choose a temporary unit, then check this flower rather than using a fixed ratio.
